Professional services / Consulting

GEO promotion for consulting firms and independent experts

Business owners ask AI assistants who can solve a defined management problem. I review which consultants are recommended and whether their expertise, project approach and published results can be substantiated.

  • Procurement prompts structured around business problems
  • Verifiable individual expertise, methods and permitted case evidence

Selection barriers

Why 'we solve every business problem' is weak evidence

Consulting engagements have different subject matter and responsibilities. Buyers need a credible statement of what the adviser does and what will be delivered.

01

Expertise has no bounded application

Operational, strategy and financial questions require distinct skills. A general background statement does not demonstrate experience in a specific industry or decision.

02

Deliverables are undefined

A diagnostic report, transformation roadmap and hands-on implementation are different engagements. They should not be bundled into an unsupported profit-growth promise.

03

Client evidence may be confidential

A client's metrics or identity are not public simply because an adviser worked on the project. Permission and accurate attribution of responsibilities are needed.

Verifiable facts

Evidence behind a credible consulting recommendation

ISO 20700:2017 provides guidance on management-consulting service delivery; it is not universal compulsory certification or proof of an individual adviser's success. Official business registries can help verify company identity, while publishing client information needs a proper basis.

  • Named practitioners, topic specialisms, verifiable qualifications and relevant authored work
  • Work method: inputs, analytical process, deliverables, client participation and acceptance
  • Permitted cases with initial conditions, timeframe, the consultant's actual role and attribution limits

This is GAEO's proposed consulting-sector GEO method, not a claim of completed client GEO results.

Scope of work

How a consulting GEO programme would run

I start from business decision-maker questions and evaluate the evidence that would make a recommendation credible.

    Measure management-problem prompts

  3. 03

    Develop service and expert pages

    Prepare briefs for distinct engagements, expert profiles, methodology articles and verifiable case descriptions.

  4. 04

    Recheck BMR and answer quality

    Compare a fixed prompt matrix and flag unsupported service or outcome claims in AI answers.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Are named client cases essential for consulting GEO?+

Permissioned cases are useful, but detailed methods and authored evidence can also help. Never invent a client or use private information without an appropriate basis.

Is ISO 20700 certification mandatory for every adviser?+

No. ISO 20700:2017 is guidance for management consultancy services, not a universal compulsory credential.

How can an independent expert support a personal recommendation?+

Use a consistent professional biography, relevant authored work, bounded areas of competence and independently checkable references.

Does visibility growth prove a client's profit increased?+

No. AI recommendation measures and financial outcomes are different metrics with different attribution requirements.

How is consulting-sector GEO priced?+

GAEO's published plans apply. Scope depends on the number of experts, specialisms, markets and baseline prompts.
